definitions.gloss: Japanese maple, the most common ornamental maple in Japan
definitions.explanation: The most widespread maple species in Japan, with small, deeply lobed leaves that turn vivid red or orange in autumn. Usually just called もみじ in everyday speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{伊呂波楓|いろはもみじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}えた→植える：01210_ueru⟧。
examples.english: I planted a Japanese maple in the garden.

examples.japanese: {伊呂波楓|いろはもみじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The autumn foliage of the Japanese maple is beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{楓|かえで}→楓：04375_kaede⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{伊呂波楓|いろはもみじ}という⟦{品種|ひんしゅ}→品種：11840_hinshu⟧だ。
examples.english: This maple is a variety called iroha-momiji.

notes:
The most common ⟦{楓|かえで}→楓：04375_kaede⟧ species in Japan (Acer palmatum), also called いろは⟦{楓|かえで}→楓：04375_kaede⟧. Its small leaf, split into five to seven pointed lobes, was traditionally likened to a hand counting out the いろは syllabary — hence the name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伊呂波楓|いろはもみじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧: iroha-momiji autumn colors
- {伊呂波楓|いろはもみじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}える→植える：01210_ueru⟧: to plant an iroha-momiji

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大楓|おおかえで}→大楓：30875_ookaede⟧: a maple variety with noticeably larger leaves, less common in ordinary gardens
- ⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧: the general word for maple/autumn leaves; いろはもみじ names this specific species
